I found Qantas and Virgin flights between Canberra and Melbourne, though I couldn't confirm live prices or exact departure times from the search results yet. You told me you were leaning towards the 6:10 PM flight on Friday 4 December, returning Monday morning.

I saved those preferences to your **Melbourne Trip** note and added a packing list for three nights of walking plus one nice dinner, noting that early December in Melbourne is typically around 20 to 23°C but changeable. We also added dinner at Smith & Daughters in Fitzroy to the itinerary for Saturday 5 Dec at 7:00 PM, along with a placeholder for an afternoon gallery visit. Reviews suggest booking ahead for Saturday nights there, so keep that in mind. You asked me to add a note to book accommodation near Southern Cross, and I saved that as a to-do.

You mentioned looking forward to the Melbourne trip honestly, just getting out of town for a few days. Before we wrapped up, you noted holding tension in your shoulders from hunching over the laptop today. I set a reminder for Friday 20 November at 9:00 AM to book the flights before you leave. It looks like a productive day planning ahead.
